summary: Add one or more class tokens without duplicates, validating all tokens before mutation.

semantics.validation: empty token => SyntaxError; ASCII whitespace in token => InvalidCharacterError
semantics.atomicity: validate all supplied tokens before modifying token set

caveats: Sequentially mutating before validating all arguments can leave partial state that browsers do not.

tests.name: invalid later token prevents all changes
tests.expected_behavior: prints InvalidCharacterError followed by an empty className
